subject: Renewal approval corridor & PO split — Acme Cloud capacity bump
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@procure.acme.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Mar 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal inquiry and PO routing constraints for Q4 capacity bump

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the renewal overview earlier this week. Procurement here at Acme needs to confirm a couple of implementation details before we can route the renewal through our portal:

- We intend to split the purchase into two POs to align with separate internal budgets (PO1 for initial committed capacity, PO2 as a top-up executed after Q4 headcount hiring clears).
- Our portal requires separate line items and a signed SOW for the first PO; can you provide a clean SOW and any required onboarding evidence?
- For vendor onboarding, we need an updated SOC2 attestation or the location of the public report.

Attached is SOW_v3.pdf (annotated with the new seat counts). Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept two POs for a single renewal and whether we need any special approval corridor from your finance or legal teams for staggered invoicing?

Target: we want to have PO1 hit our portal by Tue 14 Mar to secure pricing.

Best,
Marta Ruiz
Sr. Procurement Manager — Acme Cloud
M: +1 415 555 0182

Attachment: SOW_v3.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@procure.acme.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Mar 2028 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal inquiry and PO routing constraints for Q4 capacity bump

Marta — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. Quick answers and a proposed path below.

1) PO split: Redwood can accept two POs for a single renewal as long as the SOW and invoice schedule are tied to the same contract reference (we'll use the RDW-ACME-4392 contract id). We treat PO1 as the committed capacity invoice and PO2 as a later top-up.

2) Approval corridor: Legal needs to sign the updated SOW; Finance needs visibility on the two-invoice cadence. I'll own both approvals internally to speed this up — Karthik will coordinate finance gating.

3) Onboarding evidence: We have a public SOC2 report — link below — plus we can provide a one-page evidence bundle if Acme's portal needs specific fields.

Action plan (short):
- I will attach an internal margin & invoicing worksheet and route the SOW + invoice cadence to Legal for signature by EOD Mon 13 Mar.
- Ben will prepare a mutual action plan and DocuSign envelope to capture signatures for both SOW and PO acceptance.
- Karthik will confirm that the finance approval corridor (initial signoff + post-topup reconciliation) is acceptable.

If the timeline holds, PO1 should be pushable into your portal by Tue 14 Mar.

Laura Bennett
Head of Renewals (Americas)
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com | +1 650 555 0124

Attachment: internal_margin_calc.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Mar 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal inquiry and PO routing constraints for Q4 capacity bump

Marta / Laura — looping in a concise mutual action plan and the DocuSign next steps.

Summary (RDW-ACME-4392):
- PO1: Covers 500 concurrent seats (initial committed capacity) — invoice on signature.
- PO2: Covers up to an additional 300 seats (top-up) — invoice on execution following Q4 headcount confirmation.
- Contract linkage: both POs will reference contract RDW-ACME-4392 and SOW_v3.

I've drafted a short Mutual_Action_Plan.docx that lists deliverables and due dates; I'm including the DocuSign envelope link for signature capture: https://www.docusign.com/redirect?envelope=12345abcd

Please confirm two things so we can proceed today:
1) Acme confirms PO split is acceptable in the portal (and whether they'll accept lane=staggered_invoice).
2) Marta confirms which contact will upload PO1 in the portal so we can watch for the webhook and push the invoice.

I'll prepare the internal approval corridor notes for Legal and Finance and share them with Laura later today.

Ben Carter
Account Executive — Enterprise Renewals
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 415 555 0199

Attachment: Mutual_Action_Plan.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

Laura / Ben — quick update from procurement side:

- Portal validation: We can accept the PO split. PO1 and PO2 will be two separate uploads but must reference the same contract id in the description field — that meets our internal audit.
- Upload contact: I'll be the primary uploader for PO1; please watch for the portal webhook so you can reconcile the invoice.
- Evidence: We have a SOC2 link in our vendor system, but compliance wants the one-page evidence map you mentioned (fields: SOC2 URL, data residency statement, retention window, support contacts). Can you supply that by EOD Mon 13 Mar?

I've uploaded PO_1.pdf (initial) and will push PO_2.pdf after internal approvals in late Q4.

Next steps for Redwood: please send the evidence map and the signed SOW to procure@acme-corp.com and I'll route for final sign-off. Once signed, we'll process PO1 in the portal and trigger payment milestones.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this quickly.

Marta Ruiz
Sr. Procurement Manager — Acme Cloud

Attachment: PO_1.pdf (application/pdf), PO_2.pdf (application/pdf, pending upload)
